{{Quote|The current debate stems over which zero-point year-notation system is the best, with the Great ReSynchronization of 13 years ago and the Ruusan Reformation of a millennium ago being popular contenders.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN 45">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|life/13228_2.html|RM&S; Debates Calendar Reform}}</ref>}}
In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], a '''calendar''' was introduced by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]]. The zero point of the calendar was the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] that occurred that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The calendar remained in use for almost one millennium, until the it was replaced by a [[Great ReSynchronization calendar|new calendar]] with the [[Great ReSynchronization]] of [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]].<ref name="HNN 45" />
